purpose: test whether one shared-scope bidirectional calls query can replace repeated relation searches without reducing quality or increasing model cost

boundary.model: gpt-5.6-luna medium, standard service tier, read-only, multi-agent disabled

excluded_prep.reason: candidate binary was accidentally copied into both environments; the prepared experiment was not run and is excluded from every comparison

contract_findings.requirement: AC-SQG-011 already requires incoming, outgoing, or bidirectional calls
contract_findings.current_gap: released srcq 0.7.0 accepts only incoming or outgoing and emits one srcq.symbol.calls/v1 tree
contract_findings.compatibility: no production parser of srcq.symbol.calls/v1 was found; tests, docs and skill examples still fix the single-direction shape
contract_findings.owner: the existing symbol calls owner should preserve v1 and use a distinct srcq.symbol.calls/bundle/v1 projection for both
contract_findings.behavior_boundary: relation queries supply scope, nodes, edges and partial state; guards, effects, fallback and numeric behavior still require bounded source reads

initial_bundle.decision: reject projection; shared execution was faster but duplicated the root three times and increased both model surfaces

shared_root_projection.shape: one shared root plus independent incoming and outgoing children and branch status
shared_root_projection.decision: accept architecture probe; all three languages preserved relation and partial state while reducing both projections

explicit_source_manifest.scope_semantics: bounded direct manifest items, not complete MSBuild evaluation
explicit_source_manifest.decision: accept isolated tool mechanism; do not promote before repository implementation and affected verification

body_only_ab.identity: complete current Control versus candidate binary plus source-query body
body_only_ab.decision: reject; the model never saw the changed body or used the tool

trigger_candidate_only.identity: candidate-only adjacent probe with a more direct description
failures: source-manifest was incorrectly passed to srcq rg
one manifest path was guessed before discovery
a vimgrep pattern beginning at the return type selected target int
help and diagnostics reads plus fallback searches expanded the chain
trigger_candidate_only.decision: reject; routing succeeded but the coordinate bridge and undocumented manifest interface were unstable

qualified_name_candidate_only.identity: candidate-only adjacent probe with qualified-name bundle and updated symbol reference

comparison_control.identity: nearby complete current Control from body_only_ab; not a paired subject in this candidate-only experiment

remaining_work: both runs still performed a relation rg after the bundle
one run added two more symbol calls because it chose depth 1
one run reread manifest items despite the bounded scope result
source bodies were read repeatedly instead of one bounded behavior pass
qualified_name_candidate_only.decision: reject; the tool path became reliable but did not replace enough downstream work to beat the current Control

decision.next_frontier: a future candidate must make one qualified-name bundle replace all relation discovery and retain only one bounded behavior read; do not rerun the tested body, trigger or qualified-name guidance unchanged
